hyalia_stingingFilament.reason: Thin teal sticks read as a starfish or twig at 80px, no sting or hit point, weaker than shipped mass

hyalia_bellPulse.reason: Clean alpha, grained teal, reads as a pulsing bell shockwave; calmer and more on-element than shipped spiky ring. Loop: two identical 4-frame cycles, reset pop is acceptable for a pulse

ouroth_scorchBreath.reason: Reads instantly as a fire breath cone, tapered, grain and ember sparks; far better than shipped brown debris puff

hyalia_bellPulseLoop.reason: Loop accepted by the art-director in the proc-fx2 round 2 review: 8 frames (effectively two 4-frame cycles), reset pop acceptable for a pulse; ring phase frame/8, seamless enough
hyalia_bellPulseLoop.note: entry added by tte-art-gpu-server at the coordinator's request; verdict taken from the director's round-2 text on the same files
